searchText: I'd prefer SETCODEFROM. SETCODEFROMHASH has too many edge cases: dangling code from SELFDESTRUCT, reverts and reorgs, etc. Also, I don't really see why it would be worse with PBT. It's just one extra account read as today with PMT. I mostly say this because we have the opportunity to do things right now. Specially if we plan to move code to the trie via PBT. Code will be part of the state. And will grow overtime. We have a way to delete unreferenced code if we do refcounting or similar. And will be much harder to do in the future than now
